titles: formal fighter of Dragunov's underground arena

status.condition: knocked unconscious after a top-down Mach strike

relationships.renren-tomaru: Opponent whose old weaknesses he knows but whose new technique defeats him.
relationships.king-dragunov-arena: Fellow arena champion, stronger formal fighter.

periods.summary: Queen is a bald, heavily built male arena champion with red lipstick and two large spiked shields. He knows Renren's Runner's High data from Seven Stars betting intelligence and correctly identifies that her old Mach Greed cannot feint and loses stored speed if stopped. His twin shields should counter a linear charge, but Renren reveals Delta Force, running across walls and ceiling to attack from directly above, bypassing his defenses and knocking him out.

key_events.summary: Challenges Renren but loses to her new three-dimensional high-speed attack.
